annotations.variable_note: On average, before fiscal year 2014, federal Medicaid payments represented approximately 57 percent of total Medicaid payments. The Affordable Care Act, which expanded Medicaid coverage starting in 2014, provides enhanced federal matching rates those made eligible by the Act, leading to an average federal share for all Medicaid that averages about 62 percent.
